meta.derived_from: pixel measurements off replica/screens/demo.mp4 (188 s, 2524x1482, 30 fps) and replica/screens/reference-*.webp|png, cross-checked against replica/tmp/windows.txt
meta.clean_room: Values are our own. What is recorded here is measured geometry and colour - sizes, spacings, radii, hexes - taken from the target's rendered pixels. No resource file was read, no artwork was copied, and the target's marketing prose was not reused.
meta.unit: logical px at 100% scale; multiply by the per-monitor DPI factor at paint time
meta.scale_proof: The recording is a 200% desktop: its window measures 2374x1376 device px against the 1200x696 logical rect read from EnumWindows (replica/tmp/windows.txt), so device/2 = logical. The light composite is 1:1 - its row pitch (32), card height (73) and card gap (10) come out identical to the recording's logical figures, which is what proves the composite was not rescaled.
meta.status: measured - S02, S04, S05 and S07 come from a real screen recording. S01 still comes from a vendor composite, so its geometry carries a stated tolerance; a live capture of the overlay is still outstanding (recon.md Gaps).

measured.note: Raw samples, kept so every derived value below can be re-checked. The target's window surfaces are Mica: they are translucent, so the hexes below are the material over this machine's wallpaper and carry its colour cast. The neutral column is that cast removed, which is what an opaque rebuild should ship.

frames.S05 drill: m-95.png idle, m-120.png correct, m-150.png empty slots

accent.note: the machine's Windows accent, not the app's brand

search_underline.note: the accent again - blue on this machine's shot, orange in the recording

page.material: Mica - translucent over the desktop. shortcut-sheet paints it opaque; this is the neutral equivalent of the measurement.

overlay.note: Light surface corrected #F7F7F7 -> #FFFFFF: the composite panel is white, not off-white. Dark border-strong corrected #484848 -> #464646, the measured idle keycap edge.

text.note: Dark primary corrected #F2F2F2 -> #FFFFFF and secondary #A3A3A3 -> #CBCBCB, both measured. disabled is bumped one step above the measured #7A7A7A so it clears 3:1 against the card; WCAG exempts disabled text, we do not have to.

accent.note: The target has no accent of its own: it paints the underline, the toggles, the links and the drill ring with the OS accent, which is why the same build is orange in the recording and blue in the vendor's own shot. shortcut-sheet ships its own ramp so the clone is not at the mercy of whatever the user's theme is; the behaviour (one accent token, applied everywhere) is what is copied, not the hue.

keycap.note: Overlay chips and drill caps are two different sizes of one component; see size.keycap_* and size.drill_keycap_*.

state.note: success and danger dark values are the measured badge green (#72DA61) and the measured wrong-key tint (#F58CA4). The light pair stays ours - the recording never left dark mode.

control.note: toggle-on-knob.dark is measured #000000: the target paints a black knob on the accent track in dark mode, not a white one. banner-fill is the accent at ~18% over the page, which is why the target's banner is orange on one machine and yellow on another. Multi-word keys are hyphenated because contrast.py builds pair names from the path with '-' and an underscore silently becomes an unknown token. slot-dashed is the one place we deliberately do not match: the target's empty drill slot measures #404040 on a #222222 page, 1.5:1, under the 3:1 WCAG asks of an essential control boundary - so we ship #707070 and keep the measured pair under slot-dashed-measured. Logged as a divergence in features.csv.

type.family: Segoe UI Variable Display, Segoe UI, sans-serif

measured_cap_heights_logical.how: cap height / 0.696 (Segoe UI) = em. Every figure below is a glyph measured off a frame, not a style name.
measured_cap_heights_logical.note: lg (16) is the one step with no measurement behind it - nothing in the four screens renders at 16. It stays in the scale because the overlay's app title wants it.

roles.note: Two corrections from the measurement. count is md, not xs: the '0 / 123 mastered' line has the same 10 logical cap height as the app name above it, and only reads as smaller because it is grey. section_header is xl (20) - the hub's category headers measure 14 logical of cap height, which is 20 px of Segoe UI, not 14.

space.note: overlay_padding 12 is measured twice: the composite's row text starts 12 px inside the panel border, and the search underline runs from content edge to content edge. page_padding is the hub and settings side margin (measured 159.5-170.5 logical) - a centred column, not a fixed gutter. page_gap 10 is the vertical rhythm between every card in S04 and S07; hub_grid_gap 18 is the horizontal+vertical gutter of the hub grid, which is the one place the target uses a wider gap.

radius.note: card 4 measured as a corner curve that flattens over 5-6 device px on the settings and hub cards; drill_keycap 8 measured as a curve running ~15 device px on a 128 px cap. Both agree with the WinUI pair (ControlCornerRadius 4, OverlayCornerRadius 8), which is the strongest evidence that the target uses stock corner tokens rather than custom ones.

size.note: overlay_width 344 -> 360 and overlay_max_height 424 -> 399, both measured on the composite panel (1241..1601 x 319..718, borders included). keycap_height 20 -> 23 and keycap_min_width 20 -> 24 measured off the chip boxes. search_height 30 -> 38 is the field box plus its 2 underline. title_bar_height 32 -> 36. card_height 72 is the settings card with one line of text; 83 is the same card when the description wraps to two, so the card grows rather than clipping. detail_row_height 73 is the S04 collection row - one pixel above the settings card, which is a rounding difference in the measurement, not a second value.

stroke.note: search_underline 2 measured as 4 device px at 200% in both themes; the idle rule is 1.

elevation.note: The composite panel's edge is a 1 px #B6B6B6 border plus a soft shadow that reaches 12 px out; that is what offset_y 8 / blur 24 was fitted to.

measured_budget.source: the target's own LocalCache log, which times every one of those calls
measured_budget.note: Not animation - the target's own measured latency. Its ShowOverlay runs 9-33 ms and its search 0-15 ms, so our <50 ms trigger budget is the same order and the overlay must not add a fade longer than ~100 ms on top of it.

motion.note: Overlay appears on a key hold; any animation longer than ~100ms reads as lag. Keep show under 100ms.

overlay_row.layout: command name left, keycap cluster right, baseline aligned
overlay_row.truncate: command name ellipsizes at 60% of overlay width, keycaps never truncate
overlay_row.measured: pitch 32; name starts at padding 12; keycap cluster is right-aligned to the content edge, so a 2-cap row starts further right than a 3-cap row - the caps are not in columns
overlay_row.parity_note: recon S01: name is regular weight, keycaps right-aligned in a tight cluster

render_rules: navigation keys render arrow glyphs, function keys as F1..F24
keycap.measured: the target renders Control as the word 'CTRL', Shift as an up-arrow glyph, and characters bare - 24x23 chips with 4 between them, 35 wide for the word
keycap.parity_note: The original mixes word CTRL with glyph Shift; we use words for all modifiers for consistency - intentional divergence, logged in features.csv notes
keycap.shape: rounded rect, fill + hairline border, no drop shadow

search_box.measured: the field is a borderless box with a rule under it, not an outlined input: 38 tall, fill darker than the page (#1F1F1F on #222222), a magnifier glyph at the right end, and the accent rule spanning the full content width
search_box.focus_behavior: DECIDED: clicking the field calls Activate() on the overlay - deliberate focus change. Escape or blur returns focus to the saved target hwnd.
search_box.clear: Escape clears text first, then closes overlay

collection_header.measured: 25 tall, semibold, with a 1 px rule under it in the hub and none in the overlay

app_card.content: icon tile, app name, 'n / m mastered'
app_card.icon_fallback: letter avatar on accent.muted - never a third-party logo
app_card.measured: 198x144, radius 4, icon 44x44 centred 18 from the top, name 89 from the top, count 115, 17 of bottom padding; 18 gutter between cards; cards sort alphabetically inside a category and categories sort alphabetically

settings_card.content: leading glyph, title, description, trailing control
settings_card.measured: 72 tall one-line / 83 when the description wraps, radius 4, 10 apart, title 14 and description 12 with 18 between their cap tops, control right-aligned in the same box
settings_card.expanded: an expander chevron reveals sub-rows (Hotkey, Delay) that are the same width, 10 apart, and dimmed while the parent toggle is off

drill_keycap.idle: dashed 2 px border, no fill - the slot is empty until the key is pressed
drill_keycap.correct: white fill, #787878 border, and a #72DA61 check badge overlapping its bottom-right corner; the key's own name ('Down Arrow', 'Shift', 'Spacebar') is captioned under the row in tertiary text
drill_keycap.measured: 64 tall, 62 wide for a single character and 105 for a word like 'Ctrl', 18 apart, radius 8

progress_counter.measured: a ring around the remaining count, accent stroke ~3 wide, with the word 'remaining' under it in tertiary and a plain 'mastered' count beside it

layout.overlay_placement: centered on the FOREGROUND WINDOW rect, not the work area or screen
layout.offscreen_clamp: if the target rect is offscreen or minimized, clamp to the nearest monitor work area with 16px inset
layout.taskbar: never appears in alt-tab or the taskbar (WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW)
layout.hub_window_default: 1200x696 logical (EnumWindows, replica/tmp/windows.txt) - the recording's 1187x688 is the same rect inside its border
layout.page_column: content is centred with a 160 gutter at 1187 wide, so the column has a max width rather than tracking the window

accessibility.contrast_target: WCAG AA 4.5:1 for text.primary, secondary and tertiary on both themes - verified with replica-design/contrast.py
accessibility.keyboard: Up/Down move selection, Enter fires, Escape closes, typing focuses search
accessibility.reduced_motion: honor the OS setting: drop all fades and the shake
accessibility.note: keycap-text-light #4A4A4A on #E2E2E2 measured 7.0:1, so the target's own chips are AAA - the value is safe to copy. The accent-derived roles are the ones that move when the user changes their Windows colour, so contrast has to be re-checked against the ramp we ship, not against the measured hue.
